benchmark: ZeoSyn (Pan et al., ACS Cent. Sci. 2024, DOI 10.1021/acscentsci.3c01615; MIT license)
queries: organic structure-directing agent size shape charge and carbon to nitrogen ratio determine which zeolite framework crystallizes
gel composition Si/Al ratio hydroxide fluoride water content and alkali cations control zeolite phase selectivity and competing phases
germanium boron titanium phosphorus heteroatoms crystallization temperature and time control zeolite framework selection and phase transformation

split.note: Held-out publications; their DOIs are removed from RAG and Small KG before retrieval.

evaluation.model: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, max_depth=None) as in the source notebook
evaluation.primary: Mean over trajectories of the per-trajectory mean (over fit seeds) accuracy difference D0+X versus D0 at the same seed
evaluation.comparisons: KG+RAG minus RAG and RAG minus Agent, 97.5% bootstrap intervals over trajectories

failure_policy: At most one technical repair per slot; a failed slot is skipped and never resampled; all trajectories enter the denominator.
redundancy_policy: Reject a formula whose training-row ranks are equivalent (|Spearman| >= 0.9999) to a D0 column or an already appended descriptor; tree models are invariant to monotone transforms.
